mapper.select:
select t1.*,t2.REALNAME as assessName from TBL_CEA_PROJECT_QUALITY t1 left join TBL_STAFF t2 on t2.STAFFID = t1.ASSESSID where 1=1 and (t1.creator = #{param.creator}
or t1.creator in (SELECT DISTINCT STAFFID FROM TBL_USER_ORGRELATION WHERE DEPTID IN (${param.getDeptIds})) )
and t2.REALNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.assessName},'%'))
order by id desc

select t1.id, t1.plan_project_Id as planProjectId, t1.project_name as projectName, t1.project_type as projectType, t1.plan_name as planName, t1.plan_project_name as planProjectName, t1.project_order_name as projectOrderName, t1.plan_year as planYear, t1.zsname as zsname, t1.fzname as fzname, t1.QDCODE as qdcode, t1.SJLX_NAME as sjlxName, t1.PLAN_STARTTIME as planStarttime, t1.PLAN_ENDTIME as planEndtime from TBL_YQNS_IMPLEMENT_PLAN t1 left join TBL_YQNS_IMPLEMENT_PLAN_TEAM t2 on t1.id = t2.im_plan_id where 1=1
and t1.id in
#{item}
AND t1.project_name like concat('%',concat(#{param.projectName},'%'))
order by t1.id desc

select t1.id, t1.plan_project_Id as planProjectId, t1.project_name as projectName, t1.project_type as projectType, t1.plan_name as planName, t1.plan_project_name as planProjectName, t1.project_order_name as projectOrderName, t1.plan_year as planYear, t1.zsname as zsname, t1.fzname as fzname, t1.QDCODE as qdcode, t1.SJLX_NAME as sjlxName, t1.PLAN_STARTTIME as planStarttime, t1.PLAN_ENDTIME as planEndtime from TBL_YQNS_IMPLEMENT_PLAN t1 left join TBL_CEA_PROJECT_DECLARE t2 on t2.IMPLEMENTATIONPLANID = t1.ID where 1 = 1 AND spzt = 6 and t2.IMPLEMENTATIONPLANID is null
AND t1.project_name like concat('%',concat(#{param.projectName},'%'))
select team_leader_id as teamLeaderId,team_members_ids as teamMembersIds,fzzstaffid as fzzstaffid from TBL_YQNS_IMPLEMENT_PLAN_TEAM where im_plan_id = #{id}

select distinct t1.id from TBL_YQNS_IMPLEMENT_PLAN t1 left join TBL_YQNS_IMPLEMENT_PLAN_TEAM t2 on t1.id = t2.im_plan_id where 1 = 1 and (plan_project_id = #{assessId} or zsname = #{assessId} or fzname = #{assessId} or team_leader_id = #{assessId} or team_members_ids like concat('%',concat(#{assessId},'%')))
